entities.text:
High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Jabalpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Notice has been served upon mother of the prosecutrix.

2. This is first bail application filed by the applicant under Section 483 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 for grant of regular bail relating to FIR/Crime No. 172/2024 dated 05.05.2024 registered at Police Station Bilkhiriya, District Bhopal for the offences under Sections 363, 366, 366-A, 376(2)(n), 376(3) of IPC and Sections 5(L) read with Section 6 of POCSO Act and Section 3(1)(w)(i), 3(2)(va) of SC/ST Act.
3.

The counsel for the applicant submits that the statement of the prosecutrix recorded under Section 164 of Cr.P.C. clearly reflects that the applicant and the prosecutrix were in affair and the prosecutrix came to attend the birthday ceremony of the applicant therefore, they had developed physical relationship with the consent of the prosecutrix.
The applicant is aged about 27 years and he is in custody since 06.05.2024

thus, the applicant deserves to be enlarged on bail as charge-sheet in the matter has been filed.
4.

Per contra, learned counsel for the respondent/State has opposed the said NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:1015 2 MCRC-55737-2024 application and submitted that the offence has been committed against the minor, therefore, taking into consideration the role of the present Ravindra Meena vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 9 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/124076684/
1 applicant, he is not entitled to be released on bail.
5.

entities.text: Ravindra Meena vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Heard the submissions advanced on behalf of the parties and perused the case diary.

6. Thus taking into consideration the facts and circumstances of the case and also the fact that the statement of the prosecutrix recorded under Section 164 of Cr.P.C. clearly reflects that the applicant and prosecutrix were in affair and charge-sheet in the matter has been filed and he is in custody since 06.05.2024, without commenting on the merit of the case, the application is allowed.

7. It is directed that the applicant-Ravinder Meena shall be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in a sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned for his appearance before the said Court on all such dates as may be fixed by that Court in this regard during the pendency of trial.

8. It is further directed that the applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 480(3) of BNSS.
9. C.c. as per rules.
